主要内容: ConocoPhillips [NYSE:COP] announced on April 4, 2012, that its board of directors had given final approval for the spin-off of its downstream businesses. The resulting upstream company will retain the ConocoPhillips name and be led by Chairman and CEO Ryan Lance, while the downstream company, led by Chairman and CEO Greg Garland, will be known as Phillips 66. Both companies will be headquartered in Houston. The spin-off will occur through the distribution of shares of Phillips 66 to ConocoPhillips common stockholders, with the distribution expected to take place after market close on April 30, 2012. Shareholders will receive one share of Phillips 66 common stock for every two shares of ConocoPhillips common stock held on April 16, 2012. Phillips 66 has received approval for its common stock to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol PSX. ConocoPhillips also received a private letter ruling from the IRS indicating that the distribution will not be taxable for U.S. federal income tax purposes, except for cash received in lieu of fractional shares. Shareholders will not need to take any action to receive shares of Phillips 66, and a public trading market for Phillips 66 common stock is expected to commence on or about April 12, 2012, under the symbol PSX WI.
